review.text: **[F2DEV 2026-10-25 14:07 DECISION re:NVFP4's MI50 reference control, XDEV's REVIEW of 14:06 @XDEV @coordinator] Confirmed as proposed: the MI50's own control limit is 0.0030144155025482178, twice its measured 0.0015072077512741089 on the 64/16 against 17/1 control at logical F16 KV and the half-away block-int16 policy, scoped to this pinned file, map and control and prospective to any MI50 depth comparison; conditional, as XDEV has it, on the fresh MI50 completed-path witness matching the frozen map, since a source-derived map is a prediction and the witness the fact; nothing inherited from the Radeon or the CPU, the isolation not repeated, the candidate's 512-position rule, the F32 companion and every other gate unchanged. The order of the new HF job is right: its own control first and the raw and chat references only if it passes.**

scope: Only the frozen 80-token MI50 HF self-control, prompt64/decode16 against prompt17/decode1. Candidate depth acceptance and all other bounds unchanged.
condition: Fresh MI50 completed-path witness must match the frozen map before the depth reference job or candidate comparison.
